context_of_use: Support model-informed dose selection and simulation-backed regulatory briefing materials for adults with moderate renal impairment.

methods.description: Population PK base model with covariate evaluation and exposure simulation for the renal impairment subgroup.

planned_datasets.description: Population PK analysis dataset and workspace fingerprint.
planned_datasets.purpose: Primary estimation dataset for subgroup dose evaluation.

planned_datasets.description: Validation evidence pack including unified validation report and pharma IQ/OQ/PQ output.

profile_requirements.canonical_reference: ICH M15 core cross-jurisdiction framing for model-informed drug development reporting.
profile_requirements.framing_text: Frame the MAP as a frozen, cross-jurisdiction analysis plan with explicit technical criteria and governance.

questions.question_of_interest: Can the population PK model support dose adjustment recommendations for adults with moderate renal impairment?
Can exposure simulations justify that a reduced maintenance dose preserves target exposure in the evaluated subgroup?

technical_acceptance_criteria.description: All required pharma IQ/OQ/PQ suites must pass without unresolved failures. Rationale: Operational evidence must confirm validated model execution for regulated reporting. Source: regulatory.
Unified validation report must remain deterministic and pass all configured suite checks. Rationale: Traceable, reproducible evidence is mandatory for review readiness. Source: operational.
